chapters.title: The Kettle Is Cold
chapters.summary: Wren loses an afternoon and finds clues: a receipt from The Crossroads bookshop, a sprig of rosemary, and a note in almost-familiar handwriting. Wren meets Wen, the bookshop's owner, and that night finds the door to Hearthwood.
